articles.title: Real world clinical outcomes of deep learning based versus manual proton therapy planning for oropharyngeal cancer
articles.summary: This matched cohort study found no significant difference in oncological outcomes or side effects between deep learning-based intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) and manual planning for oropharyngeal cancer. The findings support the clinical implementation of DL-based planning for these patients.

articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 trial evaluates the outcomes of proton re-irradiation for head and neck cancer patients. Findings suggest promising locoregional control and survival, although late toxicity remains a key consideration in this patient population.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: This AAPM guideline provides updated standards for superficial radiation therapy (SRT) in dermatology and oncology. It outlines essential medical physics practices for system commissioning, quality assurance, and safe clinical delivery of low-energy x-rays.

articles.title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: This study introduces an adaptive framework for brachytherapy treatment planning that utilizes large language models to automate and optimize objective function weights. The approach aims to reduce manual planning inefficiencies and enhance plan quality through iterative optimization.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: The AAPM has released practice guidelines for superficial radiation therapy (SRT) using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays. The report establishes minimum standards for clinical delivery to support safe and effective treatment of skin cancers and benign dermatological conditions.

articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 trial evaluated the outcomes of proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer. The study concluded that proton re-RT demonstrated encouraging locoregional control and survival, although late toxicities remain a significant concern for clinicians.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: This new guidance provides comprehensive medical physics standards for superficial radiation therapy (SRT) in the 50-100 kVp range. It is designed to assist clinics in maintaining safety and quality for the management of non-melanoma skin cancer and benign dermatological conditions.

articles.title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: Researchers proposed an adaptive weight optimization framework for seed implant brachytherapy planning using large language models. The integration of a local LLM with an automatic planning algorithm aims to reduce clinical planning inefficiencies and improve plan quality.

articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 clinical trial demonstrates that proton re-irradiation offers promising locoregional control and survival benefits for heavily pretreated head and neck cancer patients. The study highlights the continued importance of monitoring late toxicities in this patient population.

articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 trial evaluated the outcomes of proton re-irradiation in heavily pretreated patients with head and neck cancer. Results indicate promising locoregional control, though clinicians should continue to monitor for late toxicities.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: This guidance from the AAPM outlines minimum standards for the clinical delivery of superficial radiation therapy. It provides a technical overview for clinics managing skin cancers and benign dermatological conditions.

articles.title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: Researchers proposed a new framework utilizing large language models to automate and optimize the weighting of objective functions in seed implant brachytherapy planning. This approach aims to reduce manual intervention and improve treatment plan efficiency.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that approximately 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a local radiation oncology clinic, raising significant concerns about patient access to cancer care. The findings underscore potential disparities in healthcare delivery for patients who may face travel burdens to receive essential radiation treatments.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) has released updated clinical guidelines regarding the use of shorter-course radiation therapy regimens for localized prostate cancer. These recommendations aim to provide evidence-based standards for clinicians managing prostate patients using modern hypofractionation techniques.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has initiated the first patient treatment in a clinical trial evaluating their ConformalFLASH proton therapy technology. The study focuses on head and neck cancer, marking a key milestone in the development of ultra-high dose-rate delivery systems.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space for patients and caregivers
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has expanded its clinical facilities by opening a new wellness space dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers during treatment. This development aims to enhance the patient experience at the regional proton therapy center.

articles.title: BayCare opens proton therapy center at Tampa's St. Joseph’s Hospital
articles.summary: BayCare Health System has opened a new $33 million proton therapy center at St. Joseph's Hospital in Tampa, expanding access to specialized radiation treatment in the region. The facility is equipped to provide precise proton beam delivery for various cancer indications.

articles.title: Medicare change could cost standalone proton therapy centers millions
articles.summary: A proposed Medicare pricing change threatens the financial viability of freestanding proton therapy centers by potentially reducing reimbursement rates by nearly 30% compared to hospital-based centers. This shift raises concerns about the long-term sustainability of independent facilities and the potential impact on patient access to specialized cancer treatment.
